releases.name: Fleet Index 2026-11-24
releases.body: Created the fleet index server for FileCensus. Phones push their file inventories to it, and any phone can ask which phone holds a given file. It keeps a searchable copy in memory and saves the data to a database. It refuses every request until an access key is set.

jobs.description: Server that lets FileCensus phones share inventories and find which phone holds a file.

releases.name: Greenscreen 2026-11-24
releases.body: Created Greenscreen version 2, a step friendly remote screen page for the Green Phone. Each page load takes a fresh screenshot, and clicking the screenshot taps that spot on the phone. It uses plain forms with no scripts. A second start script runs it behind a named tunnel at a fixed address.

jobs.description: Step friendly remote screen page that shows the phone screen and taps where you click.

releases.name: ClipRig 2026-11-25
releases.body: Created ClipRig, an Android phone app with a screen recorder, a highlight finder, a clip editor, a library, a games list, settings, and an updater. The build now uses the Android tools already on the build machine.

jobs.description: Android app that records your screen, finds highlights, and edits clips.

releases.name: Manual Rebuild 2026-11-25
releases.body: Created Manual Rebuild, a tool that turns manual figures into parts. Version 2 added a parts studio that traces figures into polygon parts and exports them as SVG. It also shows an exploded 3D view with a spin control and an explode slider.

jobs.description: Traces manual figures into parts and shows them in an exploded 3D view.

releases.name: Ascend 2026-11-24
releases.body: Added a global leaderboard that shows over the game, backed by a new leaderboard service. Added challenge, career, gauntlet, jewels, and marathon modes, each with its own leaderboard. The climb now has five height zones, solid blocks, a ghost replay, synth sound, and vibration. New pickups include shrink and grow, slow motion, and a trail blazer. The glider now burns out after ten seconds.

jobs.description: Vertical platformer with endless platforms, many modes, and global leaderboards.

releases.name: Spectral Engine 2026-11-24
releases.body: Added a MIC button that feeds any visualizer from the microphone. Fixed the Pendulum visualizer, which drew nothing. A Chromatogram visualizer was added and then removed the same day.

jobs.description: Set of sound visualizers that react to music or the microphone.

releases.name: Zion Wakes 2026-11-23
releases.body: Fixed four playtest bugs. The first load now retries the city fetch and shows a Try again button instead of hanging. Moving a place now ends after the tap and says where it moved, and a blocked spot cancels with the reason. Name it opens a field inside the game instead of a browser pop up. Street labels are now drawn once per shared edge.

jobs.description: Story and map toy set in the Agent Test Bed city.

releases.name: Data Center OSINT 2026-11-24
releases.body: The backend now runs inside the same site, so the map loads every layer without being blocked by the browser.

jobs.description: Map of data centers, power plants, heavy industry, and drought with live satellite imagery.

releases.name: Topo Wars Server 2026-11-24
releases.body: The root address now shows a status page with a link to the game instead of a not found page.

jobs.description: The backend that keeps Topo Wars two player battles in sync and sends turn notifications.

releases.name: Pajamastan Warrants 2026-11-24
releases.body: The docket now loads straight from the courts search through a built in endpoint, so the page works on Vercel with no separate server. New entries are judged by warrant date.

jobs.description: Public record page listing the active warrants docket with new entries flagged.

releases.name: Signal Snapshot Backend 2026-11-24
releases.body: The root address now answers with the service name and its routes instead of a not found page.

jobs.description: Backend that checks price bars for patterns, logs signals, and grades them.

releases.name: Signal Snapshot 2026-11-24
releases.body: The panel now talks to the live snapshot engine, so it loads instead of being blocked.

jobs.description: Panel that shows live, graded, and report views of market signals.
